name: Whole Wheat Bread
equipment: Mixer with dough hook, greased bread pans
notes: This needs only to rise once, so it can be completed in less than two hours! This bread is best if eaten within 24-48 hours. It freezes well, and makes amazing toast.

items: 2 crushed Vitamin C tablets (if using 100% whole wheat)

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Combine in mixer with dough hook: **10 cups whole wheat flour**, **3 Tbsp yeast**, **2 Tbsp salt** and **2 crushed Vitamin C tablets** (if using 100% whole wheat).

steps.title: Add the wet ingredients
steps.body: Add and mix: **½ cup honey**, **½ cup vegetable/canola oil** and **6 cups warm water**.

steps.title: Add more flour
steps.body: Scrape down the sides of the bowl and lid. Then while mixing, add **6-10 cups more flour** so the dough doesn’t stick to the sides of the bowl when the mixer is running. Additional flour may be whole wheat or bread flour. If using bread flour, you may omit the Vitamin C.

steps.title: Shape the loaves
steps.body: Form into 4 loaves and place in greased bread pans. Let rise until about 1-inch above pan tops.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Remove from pans immediately, butter tops of loaves, and cool before bagging.
